preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.
The number of pairs of interesting vertices is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
Each pair of interesting vertices consists of vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.
No pair of interesting vertices are the same vertex.

preconditions.expression: The graph is a vertex cactus
preconditions.description: Each vertex belongs to at most one simple cycle.

preconditions.expression: The graph contains no loops or multiple edges
preconditions.description: Each edge is unique and does not connect a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: Each line contains the number of distinct simple paths between the corresponding pair of interesting vertices, modulo 1000000007.
